channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Americans pay up to $2,000 for porch pumpkin arrangements, and a Texas side hustle became a six-figure franchise
item.description: Porch decorating is essentially the spooky equivalent of professional Christmas light installation, now a $3.5-billion-a-year industry.

item.title: Anthropic founders' 80% giving pledge could be worth nearly $80 billion
item.description: The seven cofounders hold about $99 billion in stock at the latest private price, but the filing calls the pledge voluntary and revocable.

item.title: One of the world's richest countries has taxed personal wealth for over a century while adding more millionaires
item.description: In Zurich, someone with $1 billion in net worth faces a wealth tax with an effective rate of 0.7%.

item.title: Holmes says she never lied; expert says deception hinged on one word
item.description: A University of Puget Sound professor says Holmes may have used paltering, true statements that create false impressions.
